dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: Um, too young to drink, are you? Well, we do sell other stuff too, like Mondstadt's famous Dandelion Wine's... brewing ingredients!

dialogues.speaker: Karpillia
dialogues.text: That's a Mondstadt specialty. It's not supposed to be in the inventory list. But since you're also an outlander like me, I will make an exception and sell you those.
